notes: Each entry is one printed parameter table; "types" lists every effect type sharing that table (the PDF prints several [n] headers above one table). list_number is the bracketed number as printed: it is the block-local (Reverb block, Rotary block) or category-local (Variation/Insertion block) ordinal, NOT the MIDI type value; effect_type/type_hex/type_number are the cross-reference into effect_types.json.
range = "Range" column as printed; value = "Value" column (raw parameter value range, parenthesised as printed); table = "Tbl No." column (Effect Data Assign Table number) or null.
Rows printed as "—" have unused=true. Rows that were printed as a bare number with no dash (Spiralizer 11-15) have unused=true and blank_row=true.

Lines "N – M: Same as the parameters shaded in gray in CROSS DELAY on page 160." were expanded: the gray-shaded rows are CROSS DELAY 13-16 (EQ Low Frequency, EQ Low Gain, EQ High Frequency, EQ High Gain) as verified on the rendered page; expanded rows carry shared_eq_block=true and the original sentence is kept in notes.
"(Ins17)" second range/value pairs are kept as alternates[{condition:"Ins17"}].
REV-X HALL/ROOM Reverb Time prints "23/24" in the Tbl No. column; stored as table=null plus table_by_type and table_as_printed.

GS1 ENSEMBLE & TREMOLO: as printed, Tbl No. 74 sits on row 8 (Tremolo LFO Depth) and row 9 (Tremolo LFO Speed, 0.1-20.0 Hz) has none; Table #74 is "GS1 Ensemble LFO Speed", so this is almost certainly a one-row misprint. Kept exactly as printed.

US HIGH GAIN parameter 1 "Type" (Raw1, Vintage1, Modern1, Raw2, Vintage2, Modern2) prints Tbl No. 35 (Distortion EQ), but those values are exactly Table #32 "Distortion Type", which no other parameter references. Kept as printed (table=35); almost certainly a misprint for 32.
Part EQ and Master EQ blocks are not effect types (no MSB/LSB); effect_type is null for them.

master_effect_block.note: Master Effect Block has no THRU type; bypass by turning the Master Effect off. The block only lists the type names below (page 171); their parameter tables are the Variation/Insertion ones. The printed list (23 names, 26 types) omits M/S EQ COMPRESSOR (Mas 7) and CS RING MODULATOR (Mas 11), which the Effect Type List Mas column does include (28 types, 0-27).
